import sys

MOD = 998244353

def fast_pow(x, y):
    if x == 1:
        return 1
    if y == 0:
        return 1
    p = fast_pow(x, y // 2) % MOD
    p = p * p % MOD
    if y % 2 == 1:
        p = p * x % MOD
    return p

def obrat2():
    return pow(2, MOD - 2, MOD)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    l = int(data[2])
    r = int(data[3])
    
    if n % 2 != 0 and m % 2 != 0:
        result = pow((r - l + 1), n * m, MOD)
    else:
        res1 = pow((r - l + 1), n * m - 1, MOD)
        if (r - l + 1) % 2 == 0:
            result = res1 * ((r - l + 1) // 2) % MOD
        else:
            term1 = res1 * ((r - l + 2) // 2) % MOD
            term2 = ((res1 - 1) % MOD) * obrat2() % MOD
            result = (term1 - term2) % MOD
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
